name: com.ohze.gameup.core
description:
Core framework for Unity game development including Singleton, EventBus, FSM, Object Pool, UI Manager, Audio, Save/Load, and more. Git UPM flow: install DOTween first (Assets/Plugins/Demigiant + DOTween.Modules.asmdef), then enable define DOTween__DEPENDENCIES_INSTALLED from GameUp/Project/GameUpCore Installer. Cursor: package ships templates in Documentation~/cursor-rules; on first editor load they copy to .cursor/rules if missing, or use menu GameUp/Project/Install Cursor IDE rules. Template repo: https://github.com/ohze/gameup-unity-template 

DuyLV 2026
